what: Planned SessionStart no-spawn regression is not observable
scenario_or_breakage: A failing python3 stub with no claude-implement-* dirs still passes if the hook incorrectly spawns python3 and then swallows the non-zero exit, so the explicit no-spawn gate is not pinned
suggested_fix: Make the stub write a marker or counter and assert it is absent, or add a small structural check that the claude-implement-* pre-check occurs before the python3 CLI call
